_about: The only record of accepted dependency risk (scripts/ci/dependency_report.py). Each entry: one advisory in one package, at most 30 days from approval; an extension is a new approval. allow_pr_introduction lets the PR dependency check accept the advisory everywhere (its allow-ghsas input is advisory-wide), so set it only when the approval says so. frontend/DEPENDENCIES.md explains each entry.

exceptions.rationale: No patched deepmerge release exists, and jest-config 30.5.2 (latest) still requires ^4.3.1.
exceptions.mitigation: jest-config merges only Jest's configuration objects from this repository's jest.config.js during tests; no request, upload or other untrusted input reaches deepmerge, and it is not in any image.
